rules.title: Allowable Annual Rent Increase
rules.quote: Allowable Rent Increase: 1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: The allowable rent increase is 1.6% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.quote: Security Deposit Interest: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.summary: Security deposits must earn interest at a rate of 4.2% for the period from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, or Capital Improvement Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work [...] Relocation Amount Due Per Tenant $8,245.00 Maximum Relocation Amount Due Per Unit $24,733.00 PLUS Additional Amount Due for Each Elderly (60 years or older) or Disabled Tenant or Household with Minor Child(ren) $5,497.00
rules.summary: For evictions based on owner or relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, or temporary capital improvement work, landlords must pay $8,245 per tenant (maximum $24,733 per unit), plus $5,497 for each elderly, disabled tenant, or household with minor children, effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant (max $24,733 per unit) + $5,497 for elderly/disabled/minor children

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.quote: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act [...] Relocation Amount Due Per Tenant $11,110.05 Maximum Relocation Amount Due Per Unit $33,330.13 PLUS Additional Amount Due for Each Elderly (62 years or older) or Disabled Tenant $7,443.90
rules.summary: For Ellis Act evictions, landlords must pay $11,110.05 per tenant (maximum $33,330.13 per unit), plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62 or older) or disabled tenant, effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant (max $33,330.13 per unit) + $7,443.90 for elderly/disabled

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Temporary Displacement Under 20 Days
rules.quote: Relocation payments for temporary displacement for less than 20 days [...] Relocation Amount Due Per Tenant Household $446.00/day (plus actual moving expenses)
rules.summary: For temporary displacement of less than 20 days, landlords must pay $446 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses, effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.exemption_note: The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
